title: Toimija history record v1
description: A durable summary of one concluded Toimija session. New optional fields may be added within v1 and readers tolerate them; changing or removing a required field requires history-record.v2.schema.json and a version bump.

version.description: Schema version. Version 1 is the only value emitted by this schema.

agent.description: Wrapped command argv from the session marker.

intent.description: The session's final declared intent, when known.

scope.description: Declared scope paths accumulated by the session.

branch.description: Branch captured in the session marker, when known.

started_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the session started.

last_seen_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the last heartbeat, when recorded.

end.description: How the session concluded or became reclaimable.

exit_status.description: Wrapped command exit status, when the command launched and returned one.

handoffs.description: Up to ten handoff notes retained from the live session directory.

handoffs_total.description: Full handoff-note count before the list was capped.

recorded_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when this durable record was appended.
